metadata.source_note: Minimal contract to open a local-only PRODUCE_MANA -> ENABLEMENT_CLOSURE bridge without parser expansion, lowering changes, or runtime mana simulation.

bridge_kind.label: produce_mana -> enablement_closure
bridge_kind.purpose: Enable a narrow local closure where explicit mana production coexists with explicit mana-costed activated payoff action text.

activation_scope.description: Bridge applies only within the same local card/profile.

required_local_signals: Profile produces at least one explicit payoff action key
activation_predicate.text_evidence_policy: Require explicit mana production wording and explicit mana-costed activated sink wording in the same local text.
honesty_constraints: Do not infer global mana payment validity.
Do not promote isolated mana rocks to generic enablement closure.

implementation_shape_expected.helper_style: Dedicated local helper, post generic i/j loop, following existing bridge insertion pattern.
